limitations: Airborne data identifies effective output inertia/losses, not tire-ground contact or traction.
Torque is nominal C620 current conversion, not a shaft torque sensor; inertia is relative to that scale.
Aggregate command-to-reported-RPM delay must replace overlapping transport/feedback delays, not be added twice.
No-load maximum speeds are measured. High-speed rolloff width and loaded torque-speed capacity are explicit priors.
Static breakaway is bounded by these records; position-dependent cogging/presliding is not uniquely identified.

prone_geometry.initial_target_rotation_source: Closed-chain mechanical prior: rotate both active axes on each side together from the declared42deg pose, bringing the wheel midpoint from about12cm behind the body origin to3.4cm; never rotates the physical reset or executes a runtime sequence
prone_geometry.wheel_action_parameterization: Fresh trainable absolute wheel-velocity targets; no measured-wheel-velocity identity added to the actor output
prone_geometry.standard_prone_definition: Body normally facing up, chassis belly resting on the floor, all six motors disabled during native settling; not forward tipped or inverted
prone_geometry.leg_target_range: Retain the existing native recovery range16: at0.25rad per action unit, +/-4rad around the nominal target. Declare the same range in the mechanism config and task settings. Paired40..107deg relative projection and native torque caps remain active.
prone_geometry.guided_path: Learn to fold the physical passive knees near40deg, move wheel support below the whole-robot COM, then coordinate leg extension and wheel velocity to stand in place
prone_geometry.knee_coordinate: Physical passive included angle: left q_L_joint2 + calibrated model zero; right -q_R_jonit2 + the same zero. Not either active motor encoder angle.

encoder_geometry.input: Four calibrated model motor angles and velocities, left hip/auxiliary then right hip/auxiliary; existing35D actor retains these encoders and IMU
outputs: physical knee included angles and rates
encoder_geometry.direction: Negative knee angle rate means folding, positive means extension; leg-length rate is measured separately
encoder_geometry.invalid: More than1mrad outside the relative-angle lookup branch is invalid and supplies no folding/alignment shaping credit; within the numerical margin, interpolate at the physical endpoint and retain native error diagnostics; physical joint limits are unchanged
encoder_geometry.validation: Independent full-link FK in CPU tests and native wheel/passive-joint truth in zero-PPO diagnostics; not real-robot encoder calibration

prone_geometry.fold_release_rule: Small potential-only folding guidance fades as wheel support aligns below the COM and as the body rises. No sustained folding reward or motor sequence.
prone_geometry.rise_translation_authority: User explicitly allows about10cm of translation during get-up while coordinating wheel velocity and hip/knee motors; no position penalty inside that radius
prone_geometry.objective_limits_authority: The quiet-goal5deg and40mm Gaussian scales are engineering reward scales, not hard acceptance thresholds. Broad height cost prevents vanishing height credit near the belly. Time cost stops only after actual stable recovery; the existing10s cold deadline is an engineering screen.
prone_geometry.excursion_limit_authority: Engineering pilot containment, not a user-approved final in-place recovery limit
prone_geometry.friction_provenance: Fixed engineering comparison, not identified real tire coefficients
prone_geometry.body_contact_during_rise: Allowed; native impact impulse, mechanical, spring, closure, numerical and timeout protection retained
prone_geometry.guidance: Normal quiet standing is the primary goal from enable onward. Encoder-derived folding/support is a small gamma-matched potential auxiliary only. No scripted targets, timed trajectory, fixed wheel speed, FSM motor takeover, teacher or donor.
prone_geometry.initialization: New actor, new critic, empty Adam; trainable output bias from declared closed-chain42deg geometry and fixed opposite common rotations of0.6rad toward support below the COM. Physical disabled reset stays103deg then passively settles. No scripted sequence or runtime target hold; every output remains trainable.
prone_geometry.randomization: wheel_leg_randomization_study_v2 profiles; retain original ground bands and explicitly record wheel-material hypothesis

evaluation.getup_xy_limit_authority: User explicitly allows about10cm during get-up; this pilot uses0.10m as its fixed screen and still reports actual peak displacement
evaluation.scope: One standard prone family only; not diverse-fall or full thirteen-capability qualification

prone_geometry.reward_objective: Ordinary upright_locomotion.reward_terms with zero forward/yaw commands and305mm height, plus broad height error and a coupled quiet supported-standing bonus; no sustained folding, alignment or partial-lift density reward

unified_getup.contact_support: temporary nonwheel support allowed; mechanical/impact protection retained
